title: Engineering Knowledge
statement: Apply knowledge of mathematics, science and engineering fundamentals to the solution of complex engineering problems.

title: Problem Analysis
statement: Identify, formulate, research literature and analyse complex engineering problems reaching substantiated conclusions.

title: Design/Development of Solutions
statement: Design solutions for complex engineering problems and design systems, components or processes that meet specified needs.

title: Investigation
statement: Conduct investigations of complex problems using research-based knowledge and research methods.

title: Modern Tool Usage
statement: Create, select and apply appropriate techniques, resources and modern engineering and IT tools.

title: The Engineer and Society
statement: Apply reasoning informed by contextual knowledge to assess societal, health, safety, legal and cultural issues.

title: Environment and Sustainability
statement: Understand and evaluate the sustainability and impact of professional engineering work.

title: Ethics
statement: Apply ethical principles and commit to professional ethics and responsibilities.

title: Individual Work and Teamwork
statement: Function effectively as an individual, and as a member or leader in diverse teams.

title: Communication
statement: Communicate effectively on complex engineering activities with the engineering community and society at large.

title: Project Management and Finance
statement: Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of engineering management principles and economic decision-making.

title: Life-long Learning
statement: Recognise the need for, and have the preparation and ability to engage in independent and life-long learning.
